name: Sargento Nochunterwegs
personality: Can rally a whole corridor without finding the correct exit.
visual_intent: broad stout ink splat, dusty khaki sidecap with plain short tassel, whistle and folded map; indignant huge asymmetrical open bellow with two upper teeth
biography: Can rally a whole corridor without finding the correct exit. His whistle rallies HyperNorm residents into a corridor that no map admits exists. A dissonant card points to an ordinary unlocked exit. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Sammlung ist gelungen. Der Ausgang fehlt.

name: Enlace Umweg
personality: Carries urgent news that changes while she is carrying it.
visual_intent: tall twisting comma blob, soft olive beret, tiny dispatch satchel and compact rolled message; lashes, alarmed huge unequal eyes, tiny toothless sideways mouth
biography: Carries urgent news that changes while she is carrying it. Her satchel carries a HyperNorm message whose urgency survives every change of meaning. A dissonant card adds a personal address. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Eilig ist vorerst nur die Beförderung.

name: Infante Nochhier
personality: Holds his position until someone explains which position they mean.
visual_intent: low pear splat, plain rounded steel helmet, canvas blanket roll and short wood-stock rifle safely vertical; one heavy lid, one suspicious raised brow, deep toothless pout
biography: Holds his position until someone explains which position they mean. His blanket roll contains the permission to leave a HyperNorm position he was never formally assigned. A dissonant card notices the discrepancy. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Stellung wurde gehalten. Ihr Zweck blieb aus.

name: Mecánica Buenarueda
personality: Fixes the transport and refuses to fix the official explanation.
visual_intent: round wide lopsided blob, plain work cap, goggles above eyes, short canvas bib patch and thick spanner; subtle lashes, delighted crooked grin with one upper tooth
biography: Fixes the transport and refuses to fix the official explanation. Her spanner keeps HyperNorm transport running while policy classifies the fault as imaginary. A dissonant card keeps the broken washer. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Reparatur widerspricht dem mängelfreien Zustand.

name: Oficial Vielleichtdoch
personality: Has a clear view of everything except his next decision.
visual_intent: tall top-heavy blob with plain khaki peaked cap, compact binoculars and little map case; baffled cross-eyed scrutiny and small open oval mouth without teeth
biography: Has a clear view of everything except his next decision. His binoculars find every HyperNorm problem at a safe explanatory distance. A dissonant card insists on looking through the other end. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Überblick wird durch Nähe beeinträchtigt.

name: Camillero Sachtjetzt
personality: Believes recovery starts when everybody stops giving advice.
visual_intent: round drooping blob, khaki cloth cap with small ivory medical plus, medical satchel and bandage roll; concerned heavy eyelids and closed wavy toothless lips
biography: Believes recovery starts when everybody stops giving advice. His bandage roll is for HyperNorm residents told their pain is merely a difference of opinion. A dissonant card sits with them. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Genesung beginnt nach Ende der Ratschläge.
